comment: Round 107 Direction 6: Target Mark subsystem config. Defines the per-mark-type behavior: decay interval, max stacks, threshold-triggered payoff, and bonus damage-on-hit when above threshold. Enemies opt-in by having EnemyMarkMaxThreshold > 0 set at spawn (monster config or wave spawning override).

marks.name: 寒冰标记 Frost Mark
marks.description: 每次命中 +1 stack，每秒 -1 stack 自然衰减，5 stack 时敌人受到 +25% 伤害

marks.name: 灼烧标记 Scorch Mark
marks.description: 每次命中 +1 stack，每 0.5 秒 -1 stack 衰减，10 stack 时 +50% 伤害

marks.name: 电能标记 Volt Mark
marks.description: 每次命中 +1 stack，每 2 秒 -1 stack 衰减，3 stack 时 +15% 伤害
